name: MNHLDG
recent: MN Holdings 近期获得数据中心基础设施合约，同时因美国芯片出口管制消息，数据中心相关股项出现下跌。公司也出现董事在闭市期内的股权交易，以及凭单转换带来的新股上市。
notable: 获得数据中心基础设施合约，价值 RM293.88 million。
董事 Datuk Dang Siong Diang 在闭市期内增持 32,000 股。
独立非执行董事 Pankajkumar A/L Bipinchandra 在闭市期内减持 200,000 股。
risks: 美国宣布新的芯片出口管制后，数据中心相关股项大幅下跌，MN Holdings 股价一度下跌近 20%。
独立非执行董事在闭市期内减持股份。
earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收 RM211.47 million，同比增长17.9%；净利 RM23.98 million，同比增长98.8%，净利率11.3%。

recent_en: MN Holdings recently secured data centre infrastructure contracts, while data centre-linked stocks declined following news of US chip export controls. There were also director dealings during the closed period and new share listings from warrant conversions.
notable_en: Secured data centre infrastructure contracts worth RM293.88 million.
Director Datuk Dang Siong Diang acquired 32,000 shares during the closed period.
Independent Non-Executive Director Pankajkumar A/L Bipinchandra disposed of 200,000 shares during the closed period.
risks_en: Data centre-linked stocks fell sharply after the US announced new chip export controls, with MN Holdings shares dropping nearly 20% at one point.
An Independent Non-Executive Director disposed of shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: FY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was RM211.47 million, up 17.9% year-on-year; net profit was RM23.98 million, up 98.8% year-on-year, with a net margin of 11.3%.
